description: List load-test runs in your workspace, newest first, each with its id, loadTestConfigId, name, status, progressPercent, stats (as in getLoadTestStatus), times and abortReason; a multi-config load test starts one run per lane, sharing a groupId. Takes optional `configId` (a load test's id: only its runs), `groupId` (with configId: the runs of one multi-config start, in lane order), `limit` and `cursor` (nextCursor from the previous page; absent on the last page). Use when: the user asks for recent load-test results or the history of one load test. The individual calls a load test made are counted by aggregateTestRuns with runType=load. Read-only. Needs testing:read.

configId.description: Filter to runs of a specific load-test config.

cursor.description:
Opaque base64 pagination cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.
Omit for the first page.

groupId.description:
With `configId`: only the runs of one multi-config group, in lane order, all on
one page. 400 without `configId`.

name: listLoadTestRuns

allOf.description:
One execution of a `LoadTestConfig`. Progress is tracked by `currentSecond` /
`totalSeconds`; the `GET /testing/load-tests/{id}/status` endpoint additionally
computes `progressPercent` and inlines the parent config.

durations.description: Accumulated test durations (used for percentile calculation).

groupId.description:
Multi-config only: shared by the runs started together from one load test,
one per test config. List them with `GET /testing/load-tests/runs?configId=…&groupId=…`.

groupSize.description: Multi-config only. How many runs the group has.

laneIndex.description: Multi-config only. Which of the load test's `lanes` this run executes.

name.description: Denormalised name from the parent config.

stats.description: Aggregated run-time statistics for a load test run.

callerIdPlatformDefault.description: Calls that fell back to nopaque's shared number (no pool number free, no default).

callerIdPool.description: Calls that presented a leased pool number (`load` use). Pool runs only.

callerIdWorkspaceDefault.description: Calls that fell back to the workspace's default caller ID (pool busy or empty).

dropped.description: Arrival mode only. Due calls not placed because the run was at `maxConcurrency`.

lateStarts.description: Calls whose system under test first spoke later than the late-answer threshold.

offered.description: Arrival mode only. Calls that came due so far (sent + dropped).

patterns.description: Calls that did not pass, per failure pattern id (see `FailurePattern`).

testConfigId.description: Denormalised from the parent config for convenience.

config.description:
Persisted load-test plan. References an existing `TestConfig` (the test plan each
virtual user runs) plus a `LoadProfile` driving concurrency over time. A
multi-config load test also carries `lanes`; the top-level `testConfigId`,
`profile` and `callerId` are then always its first lane.

callerId.description:
Where each call's caller ID comes from. `test-config` (the default): the test
config's fixed number if it has one, otherwise the pool. `pool`: always the pool,
even when the test config fixes a number — a free number with the `load` use per
call, then the workspace's default caller ID, then nopaque's shared number. A test
with a callback step always uses its fixed number.

lanes.description:
Multi-config: up to 10 test configs, each with its own load shape and caller ID,
started together as a group of runs (one run per lane, sharing a `groupId`).
Each test config may appear once. When given, it replaces `testConfigId`,
`profile` and `callerId`, which then mirror the first lane.

items.description: One test config in a multi-config load test, with its own load shape.

callerId.description: As `callerId` on the load test, for this test config's calls.

profile.description:
Load-test profile, in one of two modes.

- `concurrency` (default): `points` set calls in flight over time, linearly
  interpolated. The estimator validates monotonic minutes and
  `concurrency ≤ maxConcurrency` server-side.
- `arrival`: `arrivalPoints` set calls started per second, linearly
  interpolated; two points at the same second make a step. Dispatch is
  timed by the wall clock from the first call, and each call is placed at
  its scheduled instant. `maxConcurrency` caps calls in flight: a call that
  would exceed it is dropped and counted in the run's `stats.dropped`,
  not queued. `points` is unused (send `[]`).

arrivalPoints.description: Required when `mode` is `arrival`. Seconds must be non-decreasing.

items.description: One point on an arrival-rate profile (`mode` = `arrival`).

callsPerSecond.description: Calls started per second at this point.

second.description: Time offset in seconds from the start of dispatch.

maxConcurrency.description: Hard cap on concurrent tests at any point.

items.description: One point on a load-test concurrency curve.

concurrency.description: Target concurrent tests at this point.

minute.description: Time offset in minutes from run start.

testConfigId.description: Existing TestConfig in the same workspace.

items.description:
Variant returned by `GET /testing/load-tests/runs` and `GET /testing/load-tests/{id}/status`
that adds `progressPercent` computed from `currentSecond / totalSeconds`. The status
endpoint additionally inlines the parent `config`.
